scope: Opt-in lease-local path-authorized native node cache; local correctness evidence only, no deployment or performance claim

limits.metadata: reserved bounded hash-table capacity exposed separately

regressions: branch and extension edges with inline descendants
wrong owner/path/hash and unreachable valid backing bytes
entry and byte caps with baseline fallback
corrupt or missing authorized child preimages
cancellation before hits and authorization publication
commands: zig build test-native-state test-shadow-state test -Doptimize=debug -j2 --summary all
zig build test-native-state test-shadow-state test -Doptimize=safe -j2 --summary all
notes: Eight new cache tests use real temporary MDBX; helper edge paths are separately revalidated through uncached root walks.
A missing-node fixture initially stored an empty preimage rather than deleting its DB entry; corrected to deleteStorageTrieNode.
Caller command read budgets remain unchanged; cache hits still execute the same charged native source callback.
independentReview: Branch qualification agent found no concrete blocker in path authority, storage-root admission invariant, byte ownership, or partial failure semantics; separate from actual Opus review.
